summary.text: Regina Barrow is a Democratic member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 15 (East Baton Rouge Parish), and was elected in 2015, according to the official Senate member page. The Senate lists her as President Pro Tempore.

paragraphs.text: Barrow was elected to the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 29 in 2005 and won a third consecutive term in 2011, according to her Senate biography.
She was elected to the Louisiana State Senate in 2015.

The biography says she passed Act 264, which gives National Guard members who re-enlist the opportunity to receive free college tuition, and Act 98, which created a new economic development district for the North Baton Rouge area.

It also says she led a 2007 effort to require mandatory ethics training for elected officials and authored HCR 129, which created a task force on health services delivery and financing in the Baton Rouge region.

The biography lists her as state director for Women in Government and regional chair for the National Black Caucus of State Legislators, and says she received a 2015 regional legislator award from that organization.
It says she and her husband, James, have two children.

The page lists committee assignments including Insurance, Judiciary C, Labor and Industrial Relations, Senate and Governmental Affairs, the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee, the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, the Legislative Budgetary Control Council, the Senate Executive Committee (ex officio) and the Senate Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus affiliations including the Capital Region Legislative Delegation, the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus.
